basics.name: Pablo Benito
basics.label: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full stack developer with 3+ years building production systems: Go microservices at Mercado Libre and Python/Django APIs at an early-stage health startup. I ship end-to-end features across React, Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. AI development tools such as Claude Code and Cursor are part of my daily workflow, applied with a clear understanding of what the code is doing.

work.name: Mercado Libre
highlights: Reduced response time ~50% across production Go microservices serving around 8k users by refactoring aggregator endpoints to use goroutines
Cut technical debt and shortened new-developer onboarding from 6 to 4 weeks by establishing scalable, maintainable architecture patterns, rigorous peer review, and clear documentation
Increased test coverage from 85% to 98% by building automated unit and integration test suites integrated with the CI/CD pipeline
Delivered 9 custom RESTful APIs consumed by internal teams

work.name: Spot Health
work.summary: Django APIs for an early-stage health startup.
highlights: Improved query performance ~25% by optimizing Django SQL queries critical to product support
Accelerated test reliability by developing reusable data factories that cut test-setup time by ~40%
Contributed to a full overhaul of the primary issue-tracking dashboard in collaboration with the product team

projects.name: Firmamento & Firmamento-3D
projects.description: Full-stack web platform built and maintained end to end as sole developer: custom authentication, relational data modeling with the Django ORM, server-rendered UI, and an interactive 3D scene in Three.js.

projects.name: Grimoire
